name: Arduino Mega 2560 Rev3
description: The big classic AVR board: ATmega2560 with 54 digital I/O, 16 analog inputs, 4 UARTs and 256 KB flash for printers, CNC and I/O-heavy projects.
notes: 54 digital I/O (15 PWM), 16 analog inputs, 4 hardware UARTs; USB via ATmega16U2; 5 V logic, 7-12 V recommended on the barrel jack.
Compatible with Uno shields plus the extra 36-pin double header; 8 KB SRAM is the practical limit.
Genuine boards are pricey - clones and Mega Pro boards cost far less.
